limitations: The original publisher did not retain a source Cargo.lock in the pinned public tree; a current generated lock is not proof of original build dependencies.
The GitHub CI workflows use moving toolchain/action references and caches; public npm provenance records the source commit, not the full native dependency graph.
Embedded crate paths identify only observed compiler strings, not every statically linked package or chosen Cargo feature.
A Cargo.lock inventory includes optional, build, development and other-platform packages; their inclusion here does not assert binary linkage.

Archive license files are collected as supplied by upstream. NAPI root notices are tied to each exact published VCS commit. linux-keyutils provides a license declaration and canonical Apache terms instead of a project-specific LICENSE file; no extra approval requirement or copyright statement is invented.

This artifact does not independently reconstruct Apple SDK, Microsoft CRT/SDK, Linux system libraries, linker/runtime additions or Rust toolchain internals beyond the explicitly supplied toolchain notices.
Original npm binaries must not be relabeled as the independent source build; exact source/lock/toolchain/output hashes and target-specific runtime qualification must match shipped assets.
